description: This file defines the EventStore class, which manages in-memory storage and retrieval of event messages for testing purposes. It provides methods for receiving, finding, and removing events, primarily for testing event-driven features within the Fineract project.

classes.name: EventStore
classes.description: A component that facilitates testing by storing, querying, and managing event messages in memory, supporting batch and individual event processing.

methods.name: existsEventById
methods.description: Checks if an event of a specific type and ID exists in the store.

methods.name: removeEventById
methods.description: Removes and returns an event by its type and ID, if present.

methods.name: findEventById
methods.description: Retrieves an event by its type and ID, if present.

methods.name: findByType
methods.description: Finds all events matching a specific type.

methods.name: getReceivedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of all received events.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Processes an incoming message byte array, deserializes it, and stores it as an event, handling bulk and single events accordingly.

methods.name: getEventMessageFromBulkItem
methods.description: Creates an EventMessage object from a bulk message item.

methods.name: getDataObject
methods.description: Deserializes the data object embedded within a MessageV1.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Uses reflection to deserialize a ByteBuffer into an event object based on its schema.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all stored events, resetting the store.
